name: Sonoran Country Club
summary: Welcome to Sonoran Country Club, your private backyard clubhouse in Glendale. Play a round on The Fore at Sonoran, our four-hole mini golf course with breaks and sand traps. Cool off on the pool's sun shelf, challenge the crew to pickleball, then catch the game on the covered patio at "Bogey's Oasis." After sunset, grab a seat by the fire pit or settle into the 6 person hot tub.
description:
🏠🐢 Sonoran Country Club: 4 bedroom, 2 bath

Bedroom 1: King Bed, Primary Bath
Bedroom 2: Bunk Room - 2 Twin Over Twin Bunk Beds
Bedroom 3: Queen Bed
Bedroom 4: King Bed 
2nd Bathroom: Near Bedrooms 2-4
Additional sleeper: Futon in living room with extra linens and pillows in tv stand.
Pack and play available in primary closet.

☀️🏊‍♀️Heated Pool with Diving Area & Sun Shelf
Our ALWAYS HEATED pool features a diving area for extra fun and a built-in shallow lounging shelf where you can sit, relax, and soak up the sun. Padded pool loungers and rolling patio cooler available 24/7. Water volleyball and basketball as well.

⛳️ 🏌🏽 Custom designed 4 hole/ Par 10 Course
Compete with your crew, tally your scores, & enjoy playing unlimited rounds at The Fore at Sonoran. Set course records and share with us your Club Champion. This isn't just another putting green, it's a custom designed course with breaks, hills, valleys, and traps! 

🤾⛹️‍♀️ Pickleball/ Basketball Court
Enjoy your private multi-sport court, perfect for friendly matches, shooting hoops, and all other court activities. Pickleball net height adjusts up to 17ft for volley action of all types.

👙🩳 Hot Tub 
Take relaxation to the next level at SCC: Whether it's a peaceful morning soak, a jetted recovery session, or an evening under the desert sky - our 6 person jacuzzi is essential.

🔥🔥 Fire Pit Area
Story sharing and memory making around the club's easy to use propane fire pit. *Amenity Waiver signature required*

🍴🍻 Outdoor Living & Entertainment
Welcome to Bogey's Oasis! The perfect covered outdoor gathering space. Rustic bar, dining table, and lounge seating: plenty of space to embrace the easy pace of Sonoran Country Club living. Propane grill for your personal use and an outdoor smart TV that swivels to all angles.

Guests have access to the full property except for the locked owners closet and the locked maintenance cabinets in the laundry room and secondary hallway. Guest do not have access to the patio storage room or the back black shed near the court. Pool and hot tub equipment is off limits as well as any lock box outlets. Guests are to leave man gate and RV gate in the backyard locked at all times.

Send us a text first or give us a call if necessary.

Quiet residential neighborhood; neighbors are out walking and running often. 

Several grocery stores and chain restaurants in the immediate area.

Personal/ rented vehicle use is best. Uber/ Lyft easily available.

A Few Things to Know Before You Arrive

Outdoor Living: SCC backyard is designed for year-round enjoyment, with heated pool, hot tub, golf, sports court, fire pit, sound system and multiple gathering spaces. 

Pool Safety: The pool is a diving pool with a deep end. Children must be supervised at all times. There is no lifeguard on duty. Please do not touch pool equipment. 

Outdoor amenities: Please supervise children around the fire pit and hot tub. Only adults should be operating the equipment for these amenities. 

Respect the Neighborhood: SCC is located in a residential neighborhood. Please respect quiet hours (11pm-7am), keep noise to a considerate level, and be mindful of our neighbors. 

Exterior Security Cameras: For the safety and security of our guests and property, 3 exterior cameras are located outdoors. Cameras monitor exterior areas ONLY and DO NOT monitor indoor spaces or areas where guests have reasonable expectations of privacy. Camera 1: Font door entry. Camera 2: Garage/ Driveway. Camera 3: Backyard/ Pool Area

NO PETS ALLOWED
NO PARTIES AND/OR UNAUTHORIZED GUESTS
NO SMOKING 
(fines of $500-$1,000)
